description: Rank districts by their share of accounts and return every district whose share reaches the 10th-highest share, including all ties at the cut.

a.request: For each branch district (`account.district_id`), count its accounts and compute that count as a share of all accounts. Show the district id, the account count and the share, without rounding, sorted by share from highest to lowest, and return every district whose share is at least the 10th-highest share: if several districts tie for 10th place, include all of them, even if that gives more than 10 rows.
a.sql:
WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
total_accounts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM account
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.district_id,
    dc.account_count,
    dc.account_count / CAST(ta.total AS FLOAT) AS share
  FROM district_counts dc, total_accounts ta
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM shares
  ORDER BY share DESC, district_id
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT district_id, account_count, share
FROM shares
WHERE share >= (SELECT MIN(share) FROM top10)
ORDER BY share DESC;

c.request: What are the top 10 branch districts (`account.district_id`) by share of all accounts? For each, show the district id, its number of accounts and its share of all accounts, without rounding, listed from the highest share down. Rank districts by their share of accounts and return every district whose share reaches the 10th-highest share, including all ties at the cut.
c.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), total_accounts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account), shares AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.account_count, CAST(dc.account_count AS REAL) / ta.total as share FROM district_counts dc CROSS JOIN total_accounts ta), ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as drank FROM shares) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM ranked WHERE drank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC

b.request: Return all districts ranked by their share of accounts (descending) where the share is equal to or greater than the 10th-highest share value, including all districts tied at the 10th position.
b.sql:
WITH district_account_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
district_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dac.district_id,
    CAST(dac.account_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) as share
  FROM district_account_counts dac
),
share_ranks AS (
  SELECT 
    share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as share_rank
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT share FROM district_shares)
)
SELECT 
  ds.district_id,
  ds.share
FROM district_shares ds
WHERE ds.share >= (
  SELECT share FROM share_ranks WHERE share_rank = 10
)
ORDER BY ds.share DESC
b.raw: Return all districts ranked by their share of accounts (descending) where the share is equal to or greater than the 10th-highest share value, including all districts tied at the 10th position.

d.request: Rank districts by descending share of total accounts and return all districts with a share equal to or greater than the 10th-highest distinct share value, showing district_id, account count, and exact share for each.
d.sql:
WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id, 
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account
),
district_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    d.account_count,
    CAST(d.account_count AS REAL) / t.total as share
  FROM district_counts d, total_count t
),
ranked_distinct_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT share FROM district_shares)
)
SELECT 
  ds.district_id,
  ds.account_count,
  ds.share
FROM district_shares ds
WHERE ds.share >= (
  SELECT MIN(share) FROM ranked_distinct_shares 
  WHERE rn <= 10
)
ORDER BY ds.share DESC
